content.tagline: Korean fragrance developer and OEM/ODM manufacturer
content.descriptor: A’ROMAFLAVUM: Korean fragrance company with in-house fragrance development and OEM/ODM production of perfumes, diffusers, deodorants and fabric perfumes
about: A’ROMAFLAVUM Co., Ltd. is a Korean fragrance company. According to its official website, it was founded in 2010 and works as an OEM/ODM manufacturer built on its own fragrance production, covering product planning, development, sampling and volume production.

The company lists a corporate research institute, a perfumery lab and a design lab. According to the company, its lab uses GC-MS analysis to develop fragrances in-house, and its perfumers and R&D team create scents under internal quality standards.

The company states that it runs Plant 1 in Anyang and Plants 2 and 3 in Hwaseong, and that a fourth plant in Eumseong is under construction. This is the company’s own description; Teranova has not independently verified it.
facts: Plants in Anyang and Hwaseong, Korea (company data)
channels: Cosmetics and home-fragrance brands looking for an OEM/ODM manufacturer
Importers and distributors of fragrance and home-care products
Manufacturers sourcing fragrances for their own products

lines.name: Fragrances
lines.note: According to the company, fragrances are developed and produced in-house, with GC-MS analysis in its own lab.

lines.name: Aroma chemicals and essential oils
lines.note: The company states that it imports aroma chemicals and essential oils in bulk and can also supply them in small quantities.

lines.name: Diffusers and air fresheners
lines.note: According to the company, custom home-fragrance products: diffusers, car fresheners, plaster, spray and gel air fresheners.

lines.name: Deodorants and fabric perfumes
lines.note: According to the company, odour-control products and fabric perfumes on a fermented-alcohol base with its own deodorising blend.

lines.name: Perfumes
lines.note: According to the company, perfumes including solid perfumes, alongside other fragranced products such as mists and hand creams.

tech.name: In-house GC-MS analysis
tech.note: According to the company, its fragrance lab uses GC-MS systems to analyse fragrance materials and develop fragrances in-house.

tech.name: One-stop OEM/ODM
tech.note: The company describes the full cycle: product planning, fragrance selection and blending, product safety notification, container and box design, production and quality control, packaging, final inspection and delivery.

tech.name: Four-stage quality control
tech.note: According to the company: inspection of incoming components, in-process checks including specific gravity and refractive index, final inspection of finished goods, and a QA report to the client before shipment.
